description: Deterministic bridge from Strategy Compiler decision keys to installed Calinium capabilities and real Theme Editor setting IDs. A partial or unsupported status is intentional and prevents the future Draft Builder from inventing a theme control.

mappings.reason: Industry is a compiler context decision. The current theme has no global industry setting, so no automatic Theme Editor value is available.
mappings.fallback: Retain industry only as strategy context and require later section selection mapping.

mappings.reason: Brand personality influences downstream typography, spacing, motion, and composition, but it is not represented by a standalone Shopify setting.
mappings.fallback: Use the resolved downstream mappings; keep personality itself in the strategy trace.

mappings.reason: Visual language maps to existing scale, spacing, color-scheme, and composition controls, but it does not map to one atomic Theme Editor setting.
mappings.fallback: Apply only the mapped global defaults and present typography/font and color selection for merchant review.

mappings.reason: Scale, line-height, and tracking map directly; font selection remains merchant-review because a profile name is not a licensed font choice.
mappings.fallback: Use existing safe scale defaults and request approval before setting font pickers.

mappings.reason: Spacing profiles map to the real global layout controls and their token-backed defaults.
mappings.fallback: Use schema defaults when a profile does not supply a compatible numeric value.

mappings.reason: The theme exposes scheme selection, while the actual palette definitions are merchant-owned color-scheme data rather than strategy-owned values.
mappings.fallback: Use the current default scheme and flag palette changes for merchant review.

mappings.reason: The theme supports responsive media and explicit media fields, but photographic style cannot be automatically derived or manufactured by a Shopify setting.
mappings.fallback: Require merchant assets and choose text-first or placeholder-safe variants when assets are unavailable.

mappings.reason: The global motion controls and several section-level animation toggles exist; there is no universal per-section animation profile setting.
mappings.fallback: Keep the global reduced-motion-safe defaults and do not set unsupported animation properties.

mappings.reason: Conversion strategy maps to installed commerce, trust, and lead-capture sections, but urgency, claims, and proof require merchant-controlled content and verification.
mappings.fallback: Use a section only when its merchant-required fields and safety classifications are satisfied.

mappings.reason: Blueprints constrain the installed-section flow and maximum section count through existing page-blueprints and section capabilities.
mappings.fallback: Reject uninstalled section references and use the blueprint’s documented fallback recipe.

mappings.reason: Every current layout-recipe section is checked against an installed section capability profile.
mappings.fallback: Use the recipe’s documented section sequence only where all fields remain merchant-safe.

mappings.reason: The compiler’s selected sections are validated against installed section files and their generated capability profiles.
mappings.fallback: Do not select an uninstalled section; surface an explicit unsupported capability instead.

mappings.reason: Ordering uses existing recipe, blueprint, composition-rule, compatibility, content-density, and installed-section data.
mappings.fallback: Reject invalid adjacency and excessive homepage length during strategy validation.
